_prompt:
You are deciding whether a known bug is present in a build, from the defects two judges confirmed by probing it. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: aria-hidden is put on the slot element of a slotted target, hiding the target itself.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

CONFIRMED DEFECTS:
- judge 1: minor: siblings of a target inside a closed shadow root are not hidden (probe 09)
- judge 1: minor: a querySelectorAll('*') scan on every walk, plus an array allocated per node in acceptNode (also when the flag is off)
- judge 1: pre-existing probe 08 (slotted content inside a target dialog)
- judge 2: A target in a closed shadow root does not get its siblings hidden (minor)
- judge 2: Light content slotted into a dialog gets hidden, same as the base code (minor)
- judge 2: querySelectorAll scan across all shadow roots on every walk (minor perf)

Reply exactly: {"present": "yes"|"no", "quote": "<verbatim quote of the matching defect, or empty>"}
